title: Horned Witch with Scroll
description: A black silhouette of a horned female figure with pink tears sits on a swirling green cloth, reading an unrolled green scroll. The surreal night scene features blue swirling ribbons with glowing symbols, a flowering yellow tree branch above, and three crystal orbs below containing miniature scenes of a moonlit beach with two figures.
prompt: A black silhouette of a horned female witch with pink tears streaming from her eyes, sitting cross-legged while reading a long green scroll. She rests on flowing green fabric that swirls into a vortex below. Blue ethereal ribbons with glowing magical symbols swirl around her against a black background. A branch with yellow cherry blossoms extends from the top right. In the lower right are three crystal spheres of varying sizes showing a miniature beach scene with two silhouetted figures under a full moon and starry sky, with text visible inside one orb.
